name: Attention temperature
plain: Changes the softmax sharpness of self or cross attention, with options to tune it from resolution or token variance. Higher temperature flattens attention. Extraltodeus's node replaces attention by block.
math:
scale = 1/(√d·T/T_pre·T_auto); SDPA(q,k,v,scale=scale).
T_pre=log(q.size(-2), layer_dim) with scale_before; output multiplied by the same log with scale_after; T_auto from coefficient of variation of q, k or v.

props.architectures: SD1.5, SDXL layer tables (SD_layer_dims); ppm's temperature_sampling is separate (predict_noise wrapper; not read).

providers.author: Extraltodeus
providers.note: experimental_temperature.py; not opened, kind inferred from name

label: from code
surprise: The node eval()s a user string on tensor sizes inside attention (lines 79, 93).

audit.note: T_auto is not a coefficient of variation in the default modes. cv_temperature returns 1/std(x) (optionally squared, sqrt or reversed); only "creative" modes use a ratio, std(|x−std|)/std, inverted (Extraltodeus__Stable-Diffusion-temperature-settings/nodes.py:20-34). T_pre and the output scale also fall back to log(√(X·Y), Original_scale) when no layer match applies (lines 63-64, 75-76).
